7694.title: Repeated timeline normalization and unstable cached row projections
7694.rootCauseOneLine: Array-only view caching rebuilds stable row projections, while unchanged loaded rows are recursively self-joined again.

prReviews.topFinding: Diff targets both observed causes; the linked branch was not executed.

7694.proposedFix: Preserve once-per-row recursive normalization, then reuse unchanged row projections and closed-step wrappers.
7694.caveats: No UI profiling; full build blocked by unrelated unbuilt SDK subpaths. No duplicate fix PR because #7701 already links this issue. Full repro source and sanitized results are inline; raw artifacts remain outside the reports repository.
